scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Have you finished hunting the 50 Zhu Po Long?
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
你獵殺夠50只年獸了嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: I want to quit
scripts.translation: 我想放棄

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Hmm, I don't think you've hunted 50 yet.
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
嗯，你好像還沒獵殺夠50只。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Remember, I need help hunting Zhu Po Long so go and hunt 50 of them.
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
記住，我需要你幫忙獵殺年獸，去殺夠50只吧。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Are you sure that you want to stop hunting?
Any progress that you've made will be erased
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
確定要放棄狩獵嗎？
目前的任務進度都會清除。

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Ok then, well come back here if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
好吧，改變主意了就回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Please kill 50 Zhu Po Long in order to make this a Place were people can go to and gather Experience.
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
請獵殺50只年獸，好讓大家能在這裡練級。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Amazing, you did that with speed.
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
真厲害，這麼快就完成了！

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Oh great!
You are here to help me right?
If not, i don't know what to do with the Monsters in this Place!
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
太好了！
你是來幫我的吧？
不然真不知道該拿這裡的魔物怎麼辦！

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Great! I knew the moment i saw you that i can count on you!
I need you to reduce the Amount of Monsters which are currently rampaging on this Map!
There are to many Zhu Po Long around, which makes it impossible for the lower level players to gain good experience here.
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
太好了，一看你就知道靠得住！
幫我減少這張地圖上肆虐的魔物吧！
年獸實在太多，低等級玩家根本沒法在這裡好好練級。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
So, would you still like to help me?
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
那麼，你還願意幫我嗎？

scripts.text: Sure
scripts.translation: 當然

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Thank you for your great help with the Zhu Po Long!
Currently the Situation is stable and i'm not in need of your help anymore to kill them.
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
謝謝你幫忙對付年獸！
目前情況已經穩定，暫時不用再幫忙獵殺了。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Kill 50 of those Zhu Po Long and let me know when you're done. I will reward you for your efforts.
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
去獵殺50只年獸，完成後回來告訴我。
我會給你報酬。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
改變主意了就回來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
If you change your mind, please come back.
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
改變主意了就回來找我吧。

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Oh boy, Oh boy!
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
天哪，天哪！

scripts.text:
[Dragon Hunter]
Sorry I can't talk right now I am in a world of pain here, these darn Zhu Po Long are going to kill me.
scripts.translation:
[屠龍者]
抱歉，顧不上說話了，我正受苦呢，這些該死的年獸快要我的命了。
